notes: stateAt20C and meltingPoint are from PubChem element records.
atomicRadiusNonbondedPm uses RSC Atomic radius, non-bonded values converted from Angstrom to pm.
outerElectronConfiguration is derived from the PubChem electron configuration shorthand by removing the noble-gas core when present.
atomicRadiusEmpiricalPm uses PubChem Empirical Atomic Radius values in pm; cards display this radius while detail views retain RSC non-bonded radius.
